question: Which of the following is measured in its SI-derived unit called Tesla?
solution:
The correct Answer is **__Magnetic Flux Density__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnetic flux density **is measured in its SI-derived unit Called **Tesla**.
 
• One tesla represents one weber per square meter.
 
• Formula is : T = N × A-1 × m-1 = kg × s-2 × A-1.
 
• **One Tesla is equal to a Newton per meter and ampere**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Important units of Mass__**:

 
 
• ​Kilograms: Unit of Mass.
 
• Meters: Unit of Length.
 
• Second: Unit of Time.
 
• Ampere: Unit of Electric Current.
 
• Kelvin: Unit of Thermodynamic Temperature.
 
• Mole: Unit of Amount of Substance.
